verdict.rationale: Cekura supports comparing two versions of an agent side-by-side (A/B testing) and provides dashboards/metrics for reviewing agent performance, which touches 'version' and 'review' aspects, but there is no evidence of a rollback mechanism to revert an automation/agent to a prior version. Missing for 10: explicit version history/versioning system, rollback/undo capability, and any documented workflow for reverting agent configurations.
